title: Make it yours: themes and shortcuts
p: Choose a document style that suits your writing, adjust the shortcuts you use most, and capture a quick note from anywhere. Open Settings with ⌘ ,.
A theme controls document fonts, spacing, headings, links, code blocks, quotes and dividers. It changes the page, while the sidebar and menus keep their own appearance.
In Settings › Appearance, open the document-theme picker. Hover to preview; click to apply.

td.p: The default: system fonts, comfortable spacing, dotted dividers and code line numbers.
Typography and colors familiar from Feishu documents.
Warm gray text, a narrower page, solid dividers and no code line numbers.
Purple accents for links, tasks and quotes, with proportionally scaled headings.

p: Use the theme CSS controls in Appearance to edit a theme or duplicate it as your own. Editing a built-in theme first makes a copy in your documents folder’s themes subfolder. You can restore the original whenever you want.

ul.li: Save the CSS file to update all open windows without restarting.
Unsupported properties and invalid values are skipped and listed in Appearance.
Drop another theme's CSS file into the themes folder to make it available in the picker.

pre.caption: themes/my-theme.css

p: Settings › Shortcuts groups commands by application, document, editing, text style and blocks. Use search to find a command.

ol.li: Click the shortcut on the right of a row.
Press a new combination containing Command, Control or Option.
If the combination is already used, the row explains the conflict and keeps the existing binding.

p: Changed shortcuts have a reset control, and you can reset all custom bindings at once. Menu and toolbar hints follow your changes.
A global shortcut can open a small note window while you are using another app. Write the thought down, then close the window; it is saved with your documents.

ul.li: Enable the global quick-note shortcut in Settings › Shortcuts.
The default ⌘ Space commonly conflicts with Spotlight. Choose another combination, such as ⌥ ⇧ Space, if needed. Registration failures are shown in settings.
Inside Quiet.md, press ⌘ ⇧ N or use File › New note window.
Quick-note windows remember their size and open slightly offset from one another.

td.p: Choose English or Simplified Chinese for the interface. Changing interface language does not translate existing document content.
Control automatic downloading. When disabled, remote images wait for you to load them.
See where your documents are stored.
Restore deleted pages or remove them permanently.

p: Drag the sidebar's right edge to resize it. Window sizes, Home layout and sorting preferences are remembered.
These are the defaults. Press ⌘ / to see the currently configured shortcuts.
